title: Extended Warranty Claim Denied.  Here's why
summary: A mobile mechanic live-streams about a customer's denied transmission warranty claim, explaining how maintenance records, waiting periods, and creative repair-order wording affect claim approval.

assertions.quote: the warranty company want to see receipts from the customers on how well they've been maintaining
denied claims are often the result of customer who don't understand their contract

verdicts.note: A real factor, but denial rates also reflect restrictive contract language and administrators' incentive to limit payouts, not just customer misunderstanding.

assertions.quote: they typically exclude routine maintenance such as oil changes and tire replacement
you will typically need to submit a written letter explaining why you believe your claim should be covered

verdicts.note: A standard dispute process offered by most warranty administrators, though success rates vary.

assertions.quote: when insurance company have to sell out all this money for high dollar repair jobs like a transmission they profit margin go away
you got to as the mechanic you working with is working on on your car he got to be creative

verdicts.note: Described directly as common practice by a working mechanic; a documented behavior that raises its own integrity concerns.
